Satiate your senses with really fresh food
May 2026 • Friends
Food : Excellent food with fresh ingredients 
1. Crispy Vietnamese pancakes (Banh Xeo) - it’s a pancake with shrimps and chicken with some greens. It came with a rice paper which you stuff with green leafs, pancake and stuffing and dip in the sweet and spicy sauce. It was yum 
2. Vegan vermicelli with crispy spring rolls - it came with noodles , veggies , peanuts and a sweet and mild spicy sauce you put on the bowl and eat with the spring rolls. Super good
Everything is so fresh 

Service 
Just 2 people but good service 

Ambience 
Cute humble place in the cafe apartments building with walls filled with notes by people 

Verdict : definitely must try

Limited menu, something different to choose in a quirky location
Apr 2026 • Family
We found this quirky place on TripAdvisor, it is located in a block of flats with lots of other eateries. They have 2 floors for the restaurant and we went up at least 6 flights of stairs, there is a lift which costs 3k dong to go both up and down and might be refunded by the businesses if you eat there however we wanted to see the menu before deciding so did the walk. There is a limited menu but we wanted to try something different so we went with the broken rice and pork, and vermicelli and beef dishes...which were surprisingly delicious. The walls were covered in notes from all the prior visitors, the staff were friendly and accommodating, they spoke some English and used a phone app to translate and answer any questions we had. You can't see the name from the front of the building as it's round to the side but it is definitely there!
